create_BaseBoxes_instance: create a BaseBoxes subclass instance from a tensor with shape (N, box_dim) on a specified device
convert_BaseBoxes_type: convert a BaseBoxes instance to another box type using the convert_to method with a destination type
calculate_box_overlaps: calculate IoU or IoF overlap between two BaseBoxes sets using the overlaps static method
transform_BaseBoxes_inplace: flip, translate, clip, rotate, or rescale BaseBoxes in-place using transformation methods like flip_ and translate_
create_BaseBoxes_from_masks: create BaseBoxes from BitmapMasks or PolygonMasks using the from_instance_masks static method
